item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00454","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C06","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 is a highly plausible material drafting template. It concerns the same Naval Petroleum Reserve No. 2 in California and uses the same specialized machinery: releasing surface land for non-Navy disposition while expressly retaining the underlying oil and gas for Navy control, followed by modification of the earlier reservation directive. The child adapts that structure to a housing-project sale and interagency transfer. C06 shares the simpler pattern of releasing a described portion of a prior federal reservation and modifying the founding directive, but lacks the distinctive severance of surface rights from subsurface petroleum rights. C11 similarly transfers surplus land while reserving a limited federal interest, but is less closely aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the rights to the oil and gas underlying such tract would remain under the exclusive jurisdiction and control of the Secretary of the Navy","parent_excerpt":"this elimination and reservation shall not apply to the oil and gas deposits in such lands, but such deposits shall be retained in and remain as a part of the said Petroleum Reserve No. 2 for the use and benefit of the United States Navy","explanation":"Both directives use the distinctive device of freeing surface land for another use or disposition while preserving the subsurface petroleum estate for the Navy."},{"child_excerpt":"Housing and Home Finance Agency has determined that the housing is no longer needed for public purposes, and that it cannot be disposed of advantageously unless sold in place, together with the surface rights","parent_excerpt":"lands hereinafter described ... be made available for townsite purposes and for disposal under appropriate townsite laws","explanation":"Both establish a disposal-oriented justification for releasing land within the same naval petroleum reserve."},{"child_excerpt":"The said Executive order of December 13, 1912, is modified accordingly.","parent_excerpt":"The said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 25, 1933, is modified accordingly.","explanation":"Each concludes by modifying the earlier directive that established or governed the reservation after describing the affected land."}]}
